primary_text: "I need warehouse space with a proper office attached." You need somewhere your warehouse crew can load trucks while your office staff take client calls — without shouting over machinery. These Truganina warehouses deliver exactly that. Designed from the ground up with separated warehouse and office zones, proper acoustic separation, and amenities that make sense for a working business. Off-the-plan purchase means you can customise the office layout to suit your team size. Ground-floor or mezzanine configurations available. Near Princes Freeway with West Gate Tunnel access. Stop compromising. Get a space that works for every part of your operation.
